content: In the Pairwise Word Interaction model BIBREF1 , each word vector $\mathbf {w}_{i}$ is encoded with context through forward and backward LSTMs: $\overrightarrow{\mathbf {h}}_{i} = LSTM^{f}(\mathbf {w}_{i}, \overrightarrow{\mathbf {h}}_{i-1})$ and $\overleftarrow{\mathbf {h}}_{i} = LSTM^{b}(\mathbf {w}_{i}, \overleftarrow{\mathbf {h}}_{i+1})$ . For every word pair $(\mathbf {w}^a_{i}, \mathbf {w}^b_{j})$ across sentences, the model directly calculates word pair interactions using cosine similarity, Euclidean distance, and dot product over the outputs of the encoding layer:
